title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Double Apple Shisha 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Double Apple Shisha delivers a deftly-layered blend of crisp Green Apple and sweet Red Apple flavours. The balance of tart and juicy apple notes creates a bold, satisfying vape enhanced with a smooth, fragrant exhale that perfectly captures the deep, aromatic essence of traditional Shisha. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides a consistently smooth throat hit with optimised nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio offers a great balance of flavour and vapour production, making it ideal for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, allowing you to enjoy familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
